content.value_statement: SpecDD projects need specs that match the active bootstrap chain and local ownership rules. This skill guides agents to create or revise scoped .sdd files with clear authority and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Checks that a project already has a SpecDD bootstrap file before authoring specs.
Guides agents to read bootstrap files in the defined order when context is unreliable.
Resolves relevant spec chains before planning, editing, reviewing, or reporting.
Directs edits toward .sdd files within authority granted by governing specs.
Promotes short, local, behavioral, and constraint-oriented specification text.
Reports bootstrap files, specs used, changed files, scope, and unresolved decisions.
limitations: It is intended only for existing SpecDD projects with a root bootstrap file.
It does not implement application code unless the user separately asks for that work.
It relies on available project specs to determine write authority and scope.
It stops for clarification when ownership, behavior, or security scope is unclear.

use_cases.title: Add Local Spec Coverage
use_cases.description: Create a focused .sdd file for a project area after reading the governing bootstrap and ancestor specs.

use_cases.title: Revise Existing Contracts
use_cases.description: Update nearby specs when behavior, ownership, or constraints need clearer local documentation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Governed Changes
use_cases.description: Resolve the effective spec chain before implementation work so planned edits follow project authority.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Nearby Spec
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small documentation addition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-author to add a concise .sdd spec for this feature area. Read the required bootstrap and governing specs first.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Spec Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to clarify local rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-author to revise the nearest relevant .sdd file. Preserve existing authority and make unclear constraints explicit.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Scope Before Editing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-author to identify the effective spec chain for these target files and update specs before implementation begins.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Spec Authority
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-author to review whether the current specs grant clear write authority for this change. Report gaps and suggested spec edits.

output_examples.input: Add SpecDD coverage for a new billing notifications area.
output: Identifies the bootstrap files and nearest governing specs used.
Creates or updates a focused billing notifications spec.
Reports the intended governing scope and any unresolved ownership questions.

output_examples.input: Clarify ownership rules for files under an existing feature directory.
output: Reads the relevant spec chain before changing durable project rules.
Updates ownership language with explicit path-based authority.
Summarizes changed specs and remaining decisions for the user.

output_examples.input: Prepare a governed implementation plan for a service refactor.
output: Resolves the effective spec chain for the target files.
Proposes spec changes needed before implementation work.
Separates confirmed authority from assumptions that require user input.

best_practices: Start from the active bootstrap chain before creating or revising durable specs.
Keep each spec local, behavioral, and limited to useful authority or constraints.
Report the specs used, files changed, intended scope, and unresolved decisions.
anti_patterns: Using the skill in a project that lacks a root SpecDD bootstrap file.
Changing implementation files when the user only requested specification authoring.
Inferring write authority from similar filenames or nearby code without explicit spec support.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps agents author or revise SpecDD .sdd specs inside projects that already use SpecDD.

faq.question: Can it adopt SpecDD in a new project?
faq.answer: No. The skill says to use specdd-adopt when a root bootstrap file is missing and the operator asks for adoption.

faq.question: Does it change application code?
faq.answer: No. It tells agents not to change implementation files unless the user explicitly asks for implementation work too.

faq.question: How does it decide which specs to read?
faq.answer: It directs agents to resolve the bootstrap chain, target path, ancestor specs, and relevant references before authoring.

faq.question: What should the final report include?
faq.answer: The report should name bootstrap files and specs used, specs changed, intended scope, and unresolved authoring decisions.

faq.question: Is command execution required?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written as Markdown guidance and does not require shell commands or scripts.
